news.detail: Dulcich had far and away his best performance of the season, seeing seven targets in the defeat. The tight end's next-closest number of targets was three in Week 2. The 26-year-old received over double the attention in Week 3 after De'Von Achane (knee) suffered a serious injury.

profile: role: TE1 rotational — 14% of targets, 69% of snaps.
availability: not on the league injury report.
